name: Text
description: Text is a polymorphic typography component built on Box. It maps semantic variants (h1-h6, body, lead, secondary, caption) to matching HTML tags and font sizes, while also exposing fine-grained props for alignment, wrapping, truncation, line-clamping, and optional icons. It’s meant to be the single entry point for consistent text styling across the system.

props.name: as
props.description: Underlying HTML tag to render for the text element (defaults to the tag implied by typography)

props.name: intent
props.description: Semantic color/style intent for the text (e.g. neutral, success, danger)

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Explicit font size override; falls back to preset from typography

props.name: textAlign
props.description: Horizontal text alignment (e.g. left, right, center)

props.name: typography
props.description: Typography preset mapping to tag and font size (h1–h6, body, lead, etc.)

props.name: italic
props.description: Prevents wrapping, rendering all text on a single line

props.name: truncate
props.description: Truncates overflowing text with an ellipsis

props.name: clampLines
props.description: Number of lines before truncating with line-clamp

props.name: iconName
props.description: Optional icon name to display alongside text

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Position of the icon relative to the text (left or right)
